# CAISHA Hair Donut Up-Do Hair Ring Bun Maker

## Create Fuller-Looking Updos Quickly

Give your bun the volume you want with the CAISHA Hair Donut Up-Do Hair Ring, a synthetic fiber hair styler designed to shape a full, polished bun. Slip it over your ponytail, roll your hair around it, and secure with pins for a neat finish.

## Lightweight Design for Everyday Wear

Measuring 3.6 inches (9 cm) across and weighing just 0.1 lb (45 g), this bun maker adds little bulk to your style. It works as a simple base for updos you can create in minutes.

## Benefits That Fit Your Routine

- **Fuller appearance:** Helps fill gaps for a more substantial bun, especially with fine or thin hair.
- **Versatile styling:** Creates polished looks for work, special events, or bridal occasions.
- **Custom finishing:** Pin flowers or accessories on top to personalize your updo.

## Tips for a Natural Blend

Lightly mist your style with hairspray and a touch of dry shampoo to reduce the shine of synthetic fibers and help the bun blend with your natural hair.

## Add It to Your Styling Kit

Add the CAISHA Hair Donut to your cart and start building your next updo with a fuller, more defined look.
